title: Strong Observable Substitutability and the Cumulative Offer Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2608.27784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the properties of the cumulative offer mechanism (COM) when institutions' choice functions satisfy strong observable substitutability (strong OS). First, we show that each of the following properties of the COM characterizes strong OS: IR monotonicity, weak Maskin monotonicity, and dropping monotonicity. Dropping monotonicity is a new condition weaker than weak Maskin monotonicity, and it is interpretable as a weakening of strategy-proofness and non-bossiness. Second, we show that when choice functions are strongly OS, weak group strategy-proofness of the COM reduces to individual strategy-proofness. However, strong OS is neither necessary nor "almost necessary" for this reduction.

translated_title: 强可观测替代性与累积提供机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究当机构的选择函数满足强可观测替代性时，累积提供机制（COM）的性质。首先，我们证明COM的以下每一个性质都可以刻画强可观测替代性：个体理性单调性、弱Maskin单调性和放弃单调性。其中，放弃单调性是一个弱于弱Maskin单调性的新条件，它可以被解释为策略防操纵性和非专断性的一种弱化形式。其次，我们证明当选择函数满足强可观测替代性时，COM的弱群体策略防操纵性可以简化为个体策略防操纵性。然而，强可观测替代性对于这种简化而言既不是必要条件，也不是“几乎必要”的条件。
tldr: 本文证明累积提供机制的三个单调性性质（个体理性单调性、弱Maskin单调性和新的放弃单调性）均可刻画强可观测替代性，并表明在该条件下弱群体策略防操纵性可简化为个体策略防操纵性，但强可观测替代性对这一简化既非必要也非几乎必要。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that IR monotonicity, weak Maskin monotonicity, and a new weaker condition called dropping monotonicity each characterize strong observable substitutability for the cumulative offer mechanism, and that under strong OS weak group strategy-proofness reduces to individual strategy-proofness, though strong OS is neither necessary nor almost necessary for this reduction.
